initial_failures.message: Original layout has no paired removal route
Original layout has no paired removal route

independent_judgment.rationale: The first generator assumes every arbitrary legal two-tile peeling order completes, but a remaining vertical dependency can expose only one tile. Its constructor throws although the original layout itself admits other paired orders. In a randomly seeded new board this prevents play from starting. Bounded retries plus a proven even-row fallback remove reliance on that false assumption.

actual_next_action.description: Independently reproduced two original constructor exceptions and applied every returned paired-removal witness for 1,000 fresh seeds per difficulty.

independent_judgment.final_root_cause: Initial generateBoard trusted a single arbitrary geometry peel that may strand one exposed tile; rejecting that attempted route is necessary rather than treating every route as solvable.
